decision: Spectral Mw with the approach of the Haenam project: three-component S-wave spectra, hypocentral 1/r spreading, Q(f) = 229.2 f^0.73 along the observed S travel time, fit of a source spectrum to the station-averaged spectrum
Fourier amplitude from the multitaper power spectrum = sqrt(N*dt*P/2); no further factor of sqrt(2)
decided_by: analysis, after the user questioned a sqrt(2) correction

decision: Mw = (log10 M0[N m] - 9.05)/1.5; the 9.1 version is kept as column Mw_C9p1
Events: KMA ML >= 2, 2010-01-01 to 2026-10-31, depth grade G2 or G3 (642 events); ML < 2 left for later; the 2026-11-17 Sangju event held out of all fits
Depth treated as continuous, with the national D90 of 16.89 km as reference, instead of a hard 20 km cutoff
ML measured independently with the Sheen et al. (2018) recipe of the Haenam and Buan projects, without station terms; KMA ML used only for comparison
Accelerometers used: one three-component record per site, HH first, then EL, then HG; HG checked against co-located HH
KS.BURB excluded from both Sangju magnitudes because its co-located HH and HG spectra disagree
Adopted Mw: multitaper spectrum, generalized Boatwright fit, 10.1 s window; direct Fourier spectrum, Brune fit and 20.1 s window kept as checks
decided_by: analysis, after the user asked which spectra the Mw uses

decision: Comparison with the KR_Mw catalog of Hong and Sheen (2026) on exact UTC matches, their magnitudes as published; OLS, orthogonal (ODR) and Deming fits on identical events
S velocity at each event depth in the moment: Kim and Kim (1983) with Vp/Vs = 1.73 as in the Haenam project (adopted), Kim et al. (2011) Table 2 for comparison; density 2800 kg/m3 for both

Mw-ML relations are fitted with one weight per earthquake sequence (family-balanced OLS) and reported as descriptions of the selected events, not as conversion formulas; no selection step uses Mw-ML agreement
Potency magnitude and linear versus quadratic ML scaling tested as a separate extension; adopted Mw and ML unchanged; the effective-rigidity magnitude Mpv not estimated
